cheap_features: Grayscale; remove outside black padding using >8 intensity occupancy; resize to 64 x 64 px; exclude 4 px outer margin; intensity and Gaussian-sigma-2 high-pass detail vectors each zero-centred and L2-normalised.
all_pair_scoring: Vectorised row-wise dot products in batches of 1024; correlation scores for every supplied candidate.
shortlist_rule: Union of top 800 by 0.7*detail+0.3*intensity, top 100 detail, top 100 intensity, plus all intensity >=0.985 AND detail >=0.90.
expensive_check: 256 px SSIM and ORB ratio+reciprocal matching with homography RANSAC; top 20 paired previews.
limits: Similarity does not prove duplicate images or patient identity.
Large transformations can suppress cheap correlation and evade the shortlist.
Only the initial dHash candidates were screened; absence of verified duplicates is not proof of independence.
Shared chest anatomy may create high scores and needs visual review.
No source images, labels or splits were changed.
